settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: How the app works for you. Changes take effect after you press Save.

language.title: Interface language
language.help: Kept in this browser. It does not change the language of texts the models write.

general.title: General
general.hint: Defaults for creating pictures, videos and texts.

google.title: Requests to Google
google.hint: Pace and limits for every request to Google.

jobs.title: Background jobs
jobs.hint: How many jobs run at once, and upkeep.

spend.title: Spending
spend.hint: Used to show how much of the free credit is left.

connection.title: Google connection
connection.hint: Usually filled in on the Google connection screen.

video.title: Video
video.hint: How videos are extended and how long a niche read is kept.

ideas.title: Shot ideas
ideas.hint: How long a niche search is kept.

settings.unsaved: {count} change not saved | {count} changes not saved
settings.fixFirst: Some values are not right. Fix the marked fields first.
settings.leaveAsk: Your changes are not saved. Leave anyway?

errors.sizes: Each side is a whole number from {min} to {max}.

text_language.label: Language of written texts
text_language.help: The language models write in by default: captions, ideas, briefs. It does not change the interface language.

variants.label: Variants per request
variants.help: How many pictures one request makes by default. Each one is paid.

max_attachments.label: Pictures per message
max_attachments.help: The most pictures you can attach to one message. Models take up to 14.

aspect_sizes.label: Size for each shape
aspect_sizes.help: Width and height in pixels of finished files for each shape, for example 1080 × 1350 for 4:5.

max_concurrency.label: Requests at once
max_concurrency.help: How many requests to Google can run at the same time.

max_rpm.label: Requests per minute
max_rpm.help: A new project usually allows about 10 requests a minute. Raise this only after Google raised your limit.

timeout_seconds.label: Wait for an answer, seconds
timeout_seconds.help: How long to wait for one answer from Google before trying again.

max_attempts.label: Tries per request
max_attempts.help: How many times one request is tried when Google returns an error or a broken answer. Paid failed tries also go to the spend log.

video_wait_minutes.label: Wait for a video, minutes
video_wait_minutes.help: How long to wait for Google to finish one video before giving up.

daily_cap_usd.label: Daily spending limit, USD
daily_cap_usd.help: 0 means no limit. Once today's spending (counted in UTC time) reaches this sum, new paid requests are refused until the next day.

refusal_retries.label: Repeats after an empty answer
refusal_retries.help: When the model returns nothing (for example, its filter stopped the result), the request is sent again up to this many times. Each repeat is paid.

refusal_retry_seconds.label: Pause before a repeat, seconds
refusal_retry_seconds.help: How long to wait before repeating a request after an empty answer.

image.label: Picture jobs at once
image.help: How many picture jobs run at the same time. The rest wait in line.

avatar.label: Avatar jobs at once
avatar.help: How many avatar jobs run at the same time. The rest wait in line.

video.label: Video jobs at once
video.help: How many video jobs run at the same time. The rest wait in line.

render.label: Video assembly at once
render.help: How many videos are put together on this computer at the same time. Each one loads the computer heavily.

stt.label: Speech recognition at once
stt.help: How many recordings are turned into text at the same time. Each one loads the computer heavily.

text.label: Text jobs at once
text.help: How many text jobs run at the same time. The rest wait in line.

default.label: Other jobs at once
default.help: How many other jobs run at the same time. The rest wait in line.

stuck_minutes.label: Stop a silent job after, minutes
stuck_minutes.help: A job that shows no progress for this long is stopped, and you can restart it by hand. 0 turns this off.

keep_days.label: Keep finished jobs, days
keep_days.help: Finished jobs older than this are removed from the jobs list. 0 keeps them forever.

backup_daily.label: Daily database copy
backup_daily.help: Once a day a copy of the app's database is saved to the backups folder.

backup_keep.label: Copies to keep
backup_keep.help: Only this many newest daily copies are kept; older ones are deleted.

credit_usd.label: Free credit, USD
credit_usd.help: The sum Google gave you for the trial. Used to show how much is left.

credit_days.label: Free credit lasts, days
credit_days.help: How long the trial credit is valid, counted from the trial start date. Usually 90 days.

trial_started_on.label: Trial start date
trial_started_on.help: The day your Google trial began, written as YYYY-MM-DD. Used to count the days left. Leave empty if you do not know it.

key_ban_restored.label: JSON key ban is back on
key_ban_restored.help: Turn on once the rule that forbids JSON keys in your Google organization is back on (or was never turned off). Reminders about it stop.

auto_ingest.label: Prepare videos and sound
auto_ingest.help: Makes a cover picture and a short preview for each video in the library. Done on this computer, free.

cleanup_service_hours.label: Delete helper files after, hours
cleanup_service_hours.help: Files the app makes along the way are deleted after this many hours if nothing uses them. Your results are never deleted.

max_image_mb.label: Largest picture to upload, MB
max_image_mb.help: Bigger pictures are refused on upload.

max_video_mb.label: Largest video to upload, MB
max_video_mb.help: Bigger videos are refused on upload.

max_audio_mb.label: Largest sound file to upload, MB
max_audio_mb.help: Bigger sound files are refused on upload.
